questions.question_text: Who discovered cells in a cork slice?
questions.explanation: Robert Hooke discovered cells in 1665 using a primitive microscope.
questions.distractor_rationale: Anton van Leeuwenhoek discovered free-living cells. Robert Brown discovered the nucleus.

ai_context.learning_goal: Remember the history of cell discovery.
ai_context.hint: His last name sounds like a pirate's tool.
